title: Accelerated High-Accuracy Sampling from a Warm Start via the Proximal Bouncy Particle Sampler
abstract: arXiv:2609.06905v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the problem of sampling from $\mu(\mathrm{d}x)\propto e^{-V(x)}\,\mathrm{d}x$ on $\mathbb{R}^d$, where $V$ is $\alpha$-strongly convex and $\beta$-smooth, and write $\kappa:=\beta/\alpha$. We design and analyze the Proximal Bouncy Particle Sampler (Proximal BPS), a new sampler that combines ideas from the proximal sampler and the bouncy particle sampler. From a warm start initialization with $ O(1) $ R\'enyi divergence w.r.t. $\mu$, Proximal BPS returns a sample whose law is $\varepsilon$-close to $\mu$ in total variation distance using $\widetilde O(\sqrt\kappa\,d^{1/4} \,\mathrm{polylog}(1/\varepsilon))$ gradient queries in expectation.

translated_title: 基于近端弹球粒子采样器的暖启动加速高精度采样
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在 ℝ^d 上从分布 μ(dx) ∝ e^{-V(x)} dx 中采样的难题，其中 V 是 α-强凸且 β-光滑的函数，并记 κ := β/α（条件数）。我们设计并分析了近端弹球粒子采样器，这是一种结合了近端采样器与弹球粒子采样器思想的新型采样器。从与 μ 的 Rényi 散度为 O(1) 的暖启动初始化出发，Proximal BPS 期望仅需 Õ(√κ d^{1/4} polylog(1/ε)) 次梯度查询，即可返回一个其分布与 μ 在总变差距离上 ε-接近的样本。
tldr: 该论文提出了结合近端采样器与弹球粒子采样器思想的新型采样器 Proximal BPS，在暖启动条件下期望仅需 Õ(√κ d^{1/4} polylog(1/ε)) 次梯度查询即可在总变差距离上实现高精度采样。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Proximal Bouncy Particle Sampler (Proximal BPS), a novel sampler combining the proximal sampler and the bouncy particle sampler, which from a warm start returns an ε-accurate sample in total variation using an expected Õ(√κ d^{1/4} polylog(1/ε)) gradient queries.
